summary_1line: Yudhishthira urges Bhima to abandon desire for sovereignty, teaching that mastery of the self and renunciation lead to true peace and liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A serene sage stands atop a high hill looking down at crowds below who grieve over worldly losses.
King Janaka calmly declares that even if the whole city of Mithila burned to ashes, nothing of his would truly be lost.
